content.value: Dhaka, the primate city of Bangladesh, is mostly showing divergence tendencies since all the infrastructural and technological development is centered on it. But the periphery areas of Dhaka are showing convergence tendencies, and this trend is ensuring regional growth in the adjacent towns.
